title: Basilica of the Nativity. Discovery of the Remains of an Earlier Church
author: E. T. Richmond
location_note: Church of the Nativity, Bethlehem; no map reference; placed by name. Last text page (p. 81) inferred from the next article's first page (82).
reading: p. 75 in full; then eligible-class keyword paragraphs
notes: Soundings under the floors during the structural survey: circular wall over the Grotto of the Nativity, octagonal mosaic band and walls, steps, nave mosaics, narthex and atrium evidence of the pre-Justinianic church. The Grotto of the Nativity and the Grotto of the Innocents are named as known caves below, not recorded as new features; a rock step quarried for the south wall foundation is a building cutting. No eligible feature coded.
